description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [MAG and MND +50% (25s)], [Tri-Element Mode II (Earth, Wind, Dark)], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Imperial Mode I (Emperor)] and [Dark/Earth/Wind Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Imperial Mode I (Emperor)
description.text: Dark, Earth and Wind abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Dark, Earth and Wind abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00/x2.50/x3.00 for equipped Dark, Earth and Wind abilities after casting 1/2/3+ Dark, Earth and Wind abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Causes [DEF, RES and MND -70% (8s)], grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Imperial Mode II (Emperor)] to the user, removes [Dual Awoken Imperial Mode I (Emperor)] from the user

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Imperial Mode II (Emperor)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap by 10000, Dark, Earth and Wind abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Dark, Earth and Wind abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Dual Martial Might after using Dark, Earth and Wind abilities

description.name: Dual Martial Might
description.text: Causes [ATK and MAG -50% (8s)]/[DEF and RES -50% (8s)] every 1+2n/2+2n casts, grants [Quick Cast 1] to all allies

description.name: Tri-Element Mode II (Earth, Wind, Dark)
description.text: Grants [Attach Earth with Stacking]/[Attach Wind with Stacking]/[Attach Dark with Stacking] after using a Earth/Wind/Dark ability

description.name: Dark/Earth/Wind Resonance +5% Boost
description.text: Dark, Earth and Wind abilities deal 5% more damage
